_comment: All patient-facing and clinician-facing wording. Keep patient text at about a 6th-8th grade reading level. {clinician}, {visitDate}, {deadline}, {minutes} and {count} are filled in by the app.

welcome.subject: Your visit note is ready to check
body: An AI tool listened to your visit on {visitDate} and wrote a draft of your visit note. {clinician} looked it over.
Before it goes into your medical record, you can check it. It takes about {minutes} minutes. This is your choice.
welcome.skip: Skip. I don't want to review it.
welcome.alreadySent: You sent your notes to {clinician}. Thank you.

doneForNow.laterBody: Your answers so far are saved on this device. You can come back any time before {deadline}.
doneForNow.skipBody: {clinician} will finish the note as written. If you change your mind, you can still review it before {deadline}.

review.title: Your visit note
review.aiBody: An AI tool listened to your visit and wrote this note. {clinician} checked it.
review.why: You know best what you said, so please tell us if anything is wrong before it goes into your medical record.
review.how: Tap any sentence to see what was said in the visit. You only need to mark things that are wrong, missing, or unclear.
review.confidenceSwitch: Show where the AI was less sure
review.confidenceLegend: Sentences marked like this are ones the AI was less sure about. They may still be right.

sheet.lessSureNote: The AI was less sure about this sentence. That does not mean it is wrong.
sheet.sourceDirect: What was said in your visit
sheet.question: Is this sentence right?
sheet.textLabelWrong: Tell us what is right, in your own words (optional)
sheet.textLabelMissing: Tell us what is missing, in your own words (optional)

summary.title: Check your notes before sending
summary.intro: Here is everything you marked. You can change or remove anything.
summary.none: You did not mark anything. You can send “The note looks right to me,” or go back and keep reading.
summary.messageHint: For example, a question you have.
summary.sendNone: Send: the note looks right to me

sent.title: Sent. Thank you!
sent.body: {clinician} will look at your notes before the note goes into your medical record. You will get a message when it is done.
sent.urgent: If you have a question about your care, call the clinic. If you think you have an emergency, call 911.

clinician.title: Patient corrections
clinician.intro: The patient reviewed the AI-drafted note. Review each item before you sign.
clinician.noneYet: The patient has not sent corrections yet.
declineReasons: Matches what was said in the visit
